opening.argument: The video presents an app as a way to obtain free Walmart value, promoting “free Walmart gift card and promo codes +Walmart Coupons” and stating that viewers can receive amounts ranging from five dollars to 40 dollars. It directs viewers to download the app through an external link while acknowledging that “This App isn't Available on Google play store,” then shows the app's redemption function and Walmart gift-card entries. The presentation is framed as a practical method for acquiring rewards, not as reporting, testing, or criticism of the offer. By combining a low-barrier promise of free gift cards with instructions to obtain and redeem them through the app, the video encourages viewers to pursue the claimed reward opportunity.
